name: Chengdu Xingcheng Investment Group Co., Ltd. (成都兴城投资集团有限公司)
via: Chengdu Municipal SASAC holds 90.00% of the group and the Sichuan Provincial Finance Department 10.00%; the SASAC is the group's controlling shareholder and actual controller
note: Chengdu municipal urban-development state-owned group ('Chengdu Xingcheng Group'). Per its own site it integrated Chengdu Construction Engineering Group and set up specialist companies including a football company; its member-enterprise list names both Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. and Chengdu Rongcheng FC Co., Ltd. (site page captured by the Wayback Machine, 25 July 2025). The Lianhe Ratings credit rating report of 21 July 2026 lists the club company (95.00%) and Chengdu Construction Engineering Group (100.00%) among its second-tier subsidiaries.
